resources.string: %d problem(s) would stop the game from loading:
Some problems could not be fixed automatically
%1$s is made for %2$s, but this version uses %3$s
Optional. Paste your own key from console.curseforge.com if CurseForge downloads fail. Without one the launcher uses a mirror.
Installed or fixed %1$d mod requirement(s) automatically
Renders the game below screen resolution (Resolution scale) and scales it up sharply. Lower the resolution scale to 67–85% with this on for a large FPS boost. Applies when the game starts.
Auto (GSR on Adreno, ASR on others)
Higher is crisper, lower is softer
Uses the bundled Turnip on Adreno 6xx/7xx and the phone\'s own Vulkan driver on newer Adreno, Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (Zink renderers)
Best settings: resolution %1$d%% + %2$s, driver %3$s, render distance up to %4$d, about %5$d mods run comfortably, shaders up to %6$s. Renderer: ONA Hybrid picks it per version.
The game crashed inside the renderer or the GPU driver

With the ONA Hybrid renderer the next launch of this version automatically uses another renderer. If you picked a renderer yourself, switch to ONA Hybrid or another renderer in the version settings. Lowering the resolution scale and turning shaders off also helps.
The game crashed in native code
Usually the renderer, the driver or a mod with native code. Try another renderer (ONA Hybrid switches automatically), then remove recently added mods.
The game ran out of memory
Give the game more RAM in the version settings (or turn on smart memory), lower the render distance, or remove heavy mods / shader packs.
The RAM given to the game is more than the phone can reserve
Lower the RAM allocation in the settings, close other apps, then launch again.
Launch again: ONA downloads missing requirements automatically before the game starts. If it stays missing, the mod is not available for this game or loader version.
The same mod is installed twice
Open the mods manager and delete the older copy.
Update or remove the mod named above, it does not work with another mod or this game version.
Wrong Java version for this game or mod
Turn on automatic Java selection, or pick a newer Java in the version settings.
The renderer could not create the game window
This renderer does not support this game version. Use ONA Hybrid or another renderer (MobileGlues for new versions, GL4ES for old ones).
The shader pack failed to load
Pick a lighter shader pack, update Iris / Oculus, or use the MobileGlues renderer.
Switched off for %2$s (they crash it on phones): %1$s. They come back on with another renderer.

Before each launch, lightens heavy client mods through their own settings, based on your phone: Sound Physics Remastered, 3D Skin Layers, Entity Texture/Model Features, Dynamic Lights, Subtle Effects, Distant Horizons, Embeddium, Create, Supplementaries, Falling Leaves, LambDynamicLights, Effective and Particle Rain. The mods stay installed and keep working. The original settings are backed up and put back when you turn this off (on the next launch).

Sets the video settings of the game itself once for high FPS on your phone: Minecraft (render distance, clouds, particles, shadows, V-Sync), Sodium / Embeddium / Rubidium, OptiFine and the shadow distance of Iris / Oculus shaders. Distances are only lowered. Anything you change in game afterwards stays.
Game settings set for high FPS: %1$s
Voxy needs desktop OpenGL 4.6: install the Kopper Zink and Turnip plugins and the Voxy Android compatibility mod from %1$s (Adreno 7xx/8xx). ONA uses them automatically.
Installed the Voxy Android compatibility mod
Installed %1$s: the Kotlin runtime your Forge 1.12 Kotlin mods (Better Foliage...) need
%1$s needs the Kotlin runtime (Forgelin) and it could not be downloaded. Connect to the internet and launch again

Voxy needs desktop OpenGL 4.6. On a phone that comes from three plugin apps (Adreno 7xx/8xx), downloaded from the zalith-voxy project. Tap install, accept Android\'s installer, then restart ONA. ONA then uses them for Voxy automatically.
After installing, close ONA completely and open it again so it loads the plugins.
Download failed, check your connection and try again
Physics: using the Android ARM64 build of PhysX %1$s
%1$s uses PhysX %2$s, which was only ever built for PC. Android builds exist from PhysX 2.3.1: a newer version of this mod / modpack (for example its 1.20.1 version) works on a phone.
Could not download PhysX for Android, check your connection and launch again
A mod uses a native library made only for PC (x86)
This version of the mod cannot load on a phone CPU. A newer version of the mod may ship an ARM build.
Physics Mod: its PhysX version has no Android build

ONA runs PhysX on Android for PhysX 2.3.1 and newer automatically. This Physics Mod version uses an older PhysX that was only built for PC; use a newer version of the mod or of the modpack (for example 1.20.1).
A Forge 1.12 Kotlin mod is missing the Kotlin runtime (Forgelin)
ONA downloads Forgelin-Continuous by itself when you press Play. Connect to the internet and launch again; no mod is removed or switched off.
A mod needs another mod in a different version
Launch again: ONA now finds the version every mod accepts on Modrinth (a beta too) and swaps it in. The old file is kept in the version folder under ona-replaced-mods, nothing is deleted.
Light updates were off (broken blocks turned black), turned back on in: %1$s
A mod (FPS Reducer / Dynamic FPS) held the game at a low FPS because it thought the phone was in the background. Fixed in its settings; the mod stays on

Adds a generated picture between every two game frames (motion estimated from the picture itself), so 40 FPS look like 80 on a 90/120 Hz screen. Runs only while the game is below about 60% of the screen refresh rate. Costs half a frame of input delay; fast motion and the HUD over moving parts may smear a little. Works with every renderer and version
Change the look of the launcher. All features are available in every style.
What the launcher does for you and how to use each feature. Tap to open.

Picks the best engine for every launch by itself: Krypton for older versions, MobileGlues for shaders, Sodium and new versions, GL4ES for very old versions and Zink for Voxy. If one crashes, the next launch uses another.
Renderer settings, Renderer, choose ONA Hybrid (Auto). Leave it there for all versions.

The game is drawn at a lower resolution, then the upscaler enlarges it to your screen and sharpens it. Fewer pixels to draw means much more FPS with almost the same look. GSR is made for Adreno (Snapdragon), ASR works on every phone.
Upscaler = Auto, then lower the Resolution scale to 67-85%. Sharpness 40-60% looks best. Applies on the next game start.
Reads your chip, GPU and RAM, gives your phone a score and says which versions, modpacks and shaders run well on it.
Open the device card above and press the button to apply the recommended settings once.

Sets the settings inside the game for high FPS on your phone: render distance, clouds, particles, Sodium / Embeddium, OptiFine, and the shadow quality of shaders (Iris, Oculus, OptiFine and the selected shader pack). Each file is set once, what you change later in game stays.
Keep Best game settings on. Pick your shader pack in game, it is tuned on the next launch.
Lowers the cost of heavy mods (Distant Horizons, Sound Physics, Create, Voxy, dynamic lights...) through their own settings, based on your phone. The mods stay and keep working.
Keep Lighten heavy mods on. Turn it off to put the original settings back.

Installing a shader pack also installs Iris or Oculus. Shader render targets the phone cannot draw into are converted when possible. Light packs run best: BSL, Complementary (Potato / Low), Sildur Vibrant Lite, MakeUp Ultra Fast.
Download a shader pack into the version, use ONA Hybrid, then pick the pack in game (Options, Video, Shader Packs).

When you install a mod or start a version, missing required mods are downloaded by themselves from Modrinth, also hidden ones like Forgelin for old Forge Kotlin mods. Mods are never deleted or turned off.
Nothing to do. If a toast says something was installed, just start again.
The launcher reads the crash, explains the cause and fixes what it can (renderer, memory, requirements, PhysX, Voxy).
Start again once. If it still crashes, send the latest game log.
What do you want to play?
Write what you want (kind, version, loader, style) and get modpacks, mods or shaders that fit it and run well on your phone. Smooth ones come first.
Could not reach Modrinth. Check the internet and try again.
Nothing found. Try fewer or other words.
Tap one to see it. To install it, open Download and search its name.
Rust: Horizon, Minecraft 26.3 rewritten in Rust. Its own page signs in, gets 26.3 and prepares it once. Java mods do not run in it.
This build has no Horizon (Rust) engine yet. Get a newer build.
Horizon (Rust) needs Vulkan 1.1, which this phone does not have.
From Horizon\'s reviewed list (playhorizon.dev/mods). Java mods do not run in Horizon. Restart Horizon after installing.
%1$s installed. Restart Horizon to use it
Horizon has no modpacks in its list yet. They will show here when they come
Minecraft Java 26.3 rewritten in Rust. Its own engine, its own mods, separate from Java.
Horizon is ready on this phone
Java 25 installed (Horizon uses it once to prepare 26.3)
Java 25 not installed yet: Horizon gets it when it prepares 26.3
The first start signs in, downloads 26.3 and prepares it once. In a world, the ball at the top opens the menu.
Save and send the Horizon log
Could not save the Horizon log

Horizon is Minecraft Java 26.3 rewritten in Rust by its own team (MocLG/horizon-android, MIT licence). ONA builds it into the launcher and gives it the Java 25 runtime and the .minecraft folder it already has. Java mods, Forge and Fabric do not run in it: it has its own mods.
Used the next time Horizon starts. In a world, the ball at the top opens the Horizon menu to edit the layout.
On-screen buttons, joystick and the menu ball, like Java
Hold to break, tap to place, without buttons
Look around by moving the phone
Bigger menus and text in Horizon
Done, used the next time Horizon starts
